answer.book: W02852 Goldast, Rerum Alamannicarum Scriptores aliquot vetusti (1661), a multi-volume collection of Alamannic chronicles, laws, charters, glossaries and treatises, with dedications, prefaces, indexes and a Vadianus commentary; this part runs from Tom. II to Tom. III.
